title: Compile-time branding data
description: Why branding is embedded rather than read at runtime.
body: The product's name is embedded at compile time, unlike kaava.toml which is read at runtime. The manifest points at checkouts that differ per machine. Branding is the opposite: Tauri bakes productName and the window title into the bundle when it is built, so a name read at run time could disagree with the installer that delivered it. Branding data reaches every OS-level place the name appears: window title, detached window captions, and folder picker labels.
